We guarantee to take your strapless skills to the next level. It is everything that we offer in our full scale multi person camp, but custom made for one on one coaching, or small groups. Andreas has been the head coach of Uncharted for over a decade and has coached alongside countless world champions. He’s absorbed all their knowledge and combines the best technical coaching skills from every pro rider, and delivers them to you in one coaching experience. Learn the boosting secrets that made Mitu Monteiro 3x world strapless champion. Learn to recognize the technique that gives strapless world champion Guilly Brandão the perfect strapless cutback. Unlock the secrets of Fred Hope’s never ending glide and smooth foil style. Understand how best femaile strapless rider ever Moona Whyte effortlessly carves waves.         <div class="title uk-margin-large-top">
            <h1 class="uk-article-title">Choose Your Strapless Week</h1>
        </div>
        <dl class="uk-description-list-horizontal uk-align-center uk-margin-large-top uk-width-medium-3-4 uk-text-large">
                        <dt class="dates">Dates:</dt>
            <dd class="dates">All Year Long</dd>
                        <dt class="number-of-guests">Number Of Guests:</dt>
            <dd class="number-of-guests">1 to 4</dd>
                        <dt class="price">Price:</dt>
            <dd class="price">Starting @ $3195 USD p/p</dd>
                        <dt class="pro">Camp Pro:</dt>
            <dd class="pro"><a class="uk-button uk-button-link" href="/">Uncharted Founder Andreas Lagopoulos</a></dd>
            <!--            <dt class="location">Camp Location:</dt>
            <dd class="location"><a class="uk-button uk-button-link" href="/">Cabarete, Dominican Republic</a></dd>
            -->
        </dl>
                    <p><iframe class="uk-responsive-width" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Vq20AfQLgE4" width="1280" height="720" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen=""></iframe></p>
                <div class="introtext uk-margin-large-top">
            <p id="docs-internal-guid-cfa0a8e5-7fff-555f-655d-280704907c9e" dir="ltr"><span>Uncharted Kite Sessions is proud to offer a custom private coaching week long experiences any time in Cabarete for guests to dramatically elevate their strapless kitesurfing skills. Grab your partner, best friends, or kite buddies, choose your riding discipline; strapless </span><span>surf board or </span><span>foil, and join Uncharted founder Andreas Lagopoulos any time on demand that fits your schedule for a private coaching week in the Dominican Republic. We guarantee to take your strapless skills to the next level. It is everything that we offer in our full scale multi person camp, but custom made for one on one coaching, or small groups.</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span>Andreas has been the head coach of Uncharted for over a decade and has coached alongside countless world champions. He’s absorbed all their knowledge and combines the best technical coaching skills from every pro rider, and delivers them to you in one coaching experience.</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span>Learn the boosting secrets that made Mitu Monteiro 3x world strapless champion. Learn to recognize the technique that gives strapless world champion Guilly Brandão the perfect strapless cutback. Unlock the secrets of Fred Hope’s never ending glide and smooth foil style. Understand how best femaile strapless rider ever Moona Whyte effortlessly carves waves. With Andreas’ supervision, your understanding of how to master perfect strapless kitesurfing technique will skyrocket.</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span>With everything included in this amazing package, all you have to do is show up and improve your kiting. We have luxury two bedroom accommodations in our Uncharted Villas located right on Kite Beach where we kite from our door. We feast like kings and recharge from the sumptuous catering of Caba Eats who will cook a 3 service menu to any taste desire. We have our own private cameraman to record and edit content for unparalleled coaching insight. Only when you see yourself on film do you really understand where and how you need to improve. Combined with our bluetooth headsets for on the water real time instructions, this is the definition of private custom coaching. Incredible sessions at Kite Beach, Encuentro &amp; La Boca. Downwinders from as far up the coast as we want</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span> With a degree in psychology and over a decade of experience kite coaching all levels riders from beginners to pros, Andreas’ knowledge, and ability to transmit that knowledge to the every day kiter so that they clearly understand how to use that information is the difference between a professional rider coaching you, and a professional coach coaching you. Not all world champions are great coaches; but Andreas is a world class coach whose knowledge is unparalleled.</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span>Choose your week. Choose your ride. And join Andreas in Cabarete when the wind is cranking and it suits your schedule, and see how a personalized private coaching experience will give you the skills to enjoy your time on the water even more than you do now. Yes! It is possible to love kitesurfing even more :-)</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>        </div>
                <div class="fulltext">
                    </div>
                <div class="image one uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/destinations/FounderCoaching/Choose_Your_Ride_4.jpg" alt="Choose Your Strapless Week" />
        </div>
                <div class="package-includes uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Package Includes</h4>
            <p>    •    6 night accommodations in Uncharted Villas massive two or three bedroom ocean front condo.<br />    •    5 days of unlimited coaching with Uncharted Kite Sessions founder Andreas Lagopoulos <br />    •    All food and drinks included <br />    •    5 Day structured coaching program<br />    •    bbTalkin 2-way bluetooth headsets during coaching<br />    •    Advanced kite-flying course.<br />    •    All local transport during camp.<br />    •    Guided down winders.<br />    •    Professional photography &amp; video. We have professional camera crew Cabarete Photos joining the camp that will shoot photo and video that will be used in the coaching program. A complete personalized video is available for purchase after the camp.<br />    •    Water and snacks between coaching sessions.<br />    •    Demo of Slingshot kite gear including SST, Code, UFO and Machine Kites, Phantasm foils, and Impact Surf Boards.</p>
<p>About Your Accommodations at Uncharted Villas<br />    Each guest will enjoy 6 nights accommodation at Uncharted Villas with their own room in a massive two bedroom, two bath beautiful condominium style boutique villa located on Kite Beach. With a massive kitchen, island and open concept living area, your home on the beach is sublime. With only a handful of rental units and mostly residential living, this small oceanfront residence offers the convenience of direct beach access for our kite experience, spacious bedrooms, central air conditioning, fantastically spacious living room, flat screen television for video review with surround sound stereo, large ocean view balcony that faces the Atlantic ocean, lush gardens, elevator, 24 hour security, and a beachfront pool with breathtaking ocean views that will astound.<br />    Please check out our gorgeous villa here:<br /><a href="https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/545578132569420639" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://www.unchartedkitesessions.com/uncharted-villas</a></p>        </div>
                <div class="eating uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Eating</h4>
            <p>      As always all meals are included as this is very much part of the experience. A lot of information gets passed at meals, and you actually get to know Andreas off the water in a more relaxed environment. One of the most enjoyed parts of every camp has been the fantastic food. With a background in fine dining, Uncharted founder Andreas believes amazing food is the best way to cap off an incredible day on the water. And with our private catering from Caba Eats, every meal is made fresh and to each guest guests dining desires. The food is exquisite, and the friendships that are made while breaking bread last beyond the days of the camp.</p>
<p>Please look up @CabaEats on Instagram to see their amazing menu photos.</p>        </div>
                <div class="not-included uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Not Included</h4>
            <p>Personal expenses, local gratuities, personal video, travel insurance, airport transfer and airfare.</p>        </div>
                <div class="flight-info uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Flight Info</h4>
            <p>To get to Cabarete there are several different flight options. <br />The best option is Puerto Plata (POP). It is a smaller airport, but there are daily flights from Miami, New York and Europe. It is a 30 minute taxi and flat rate of $40 USD. <br />The second best option is Santiago (STI). STI is a large city and has more flight options. It is a 90 minute taxi and flat rate of $100 USD. It is a very common option.  <br />Third option is Juan Bosch (AZS) in Nagua. It is a 2.5 hour drive and a flat rate of $150. Not as many flight options as STI. <br />Final option is the capital Santo Domingo (SDQ). At 6 million people, they have many direct global arrivals. It is a 3.5/4 hour drive and a $250 flat rate. You literally cross the entire country from south to north. <br />Uncharted Kite Sessions has a very good driver who can pick you up and drop you at our villas safely. He can retrieve you from any airport you desire to arrive.</p>        </div>
                <div class="image two uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/destinations/FounderCoaching/Choose_Your_Ride_2.jpg" alt="Choose Your Strapless Week" />
        </div>
                <div class="wind-and-climate uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Strength Of Wind</h4>
            <p>Cabarete receives 300 kiteable days per year. That’s why we choose to live in Cabarete for our coaching. Most people ride from six to twelve meter kites depending on weight. But as it is Mother Nature, and she is unpredictable, it is better to have a kite and not need it, than to need a kite and not have it.</p>        </div>
                <div class="wind-and-climate uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Wind &amp; Climate</h4>
            <p>With an average temperature of 30°C (86°F) in the summer, and 28C in the winter Cabarete is the perfect choice for our coaching series as the wind is extremely consistent due its thermal effect. The wind is predominantly from the east, as is the swell. Cabarete is consistently rated as one of the best kite destinations in the world for a reason. With access to excellent flat water oases, beautiful beach breaks, and perfect barrels over the reef, it’s obvious why we chose to make Cabarete our destination choice for our annual camps. Join Uncharted Kite Sessions founder Andreas in Cabarete and reach your true kite boarding potential.</p>        </div>
                	<div class="wind-and-climate uk-text-center uk-margin-top">
                <iframe class="uk-responsive-width" width="650" height="450" src="https://embed.windy.com/embed2.html?lat=19.842&lon=-70.409&zoom=10&level=surface&overlay=wind&menu=true&message=&marker=true&forecast=12&calendar=now&location=coordinates&type=map&actualGrid=&metricWind=kt&metricTemp=%C2%B0C" frameborder="0"></iframe>
            </div>
                <div class="gear uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">Do You Need Your Own Gear?</h4>
            <p>Yes. UKS will have some Slingshot gear for demo, but in limited quantities. Water shoes are also a good idea as we may decide to go surfing at Encuentro, or hiking the 27 water falls. If you are a beginner surfer you may need to stand on the reef. Booties are good to bring in case.</p>        </div>
                <div class="more-details uk-margin-large-top">
            <h4 class="uk-h2 uk-text-center">More Details</h4>
            <p>Uncharted Kite Sessions focuses on professional instruction on how to improve riding skills, but also integrates cultural immersion into our camps. We have video analysis to adjust your stance, kite and board position. We have an advanced kite-flying lesson that teaches you the finer points of kite control. We teach looping, self launching nod landing, luff recovery, and so much more.  And we use bbTalkin two way blue tooth headsets for on the water coaching so all instructions are clearly understood. We'll also have a flat-water specific sessions at the local oasis La Boca for practicing technical maneuvers. And we cannot fail to mention the fantastic down wind rides along the gorgeous Dominican coast.<br />From late morning every day until after dinner you'll ride, eat and learn from one of the best coaches in the world.<br />Join Uncharted Kite Sessions founder Andreas in Cabarete and reach your true kite boarding potential.</p>        </div>
                <div class="image three uk-margin-large-top">
            <img src="/images/destinations/FounderCoaching/Choose_Your_Ride_3.jpg" alt="Choose Your Strapless Week" />
        </div>
